mostWorthwhile.text: Building the portal vessel made the unusual route between two capillary beds clear and showed why the liver encounters absorbed substances before the wider circulation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the portal vessel was straightforward but offered little explanation beyond confirming the slot was filled.

surprise.text: The integrated picture added a separate hepatic arterial supply and distinguished bile ducts from blood vessels, making the liver's connections more complex than the portal route alone.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although several fittings were the only available combination and involved little decision-making.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: tracing the complete route and then seeing where nutrients go connected the anatomy to its function, even if the final picture left their processing unexplained.
